description: Read public Threads data with Desearch. Set action and that action's arguments. search (query; optional start_date, end_date): one page of posts that match a keyword. search_users (query): accounts that match a username or name. profile (username): one profile with bio, followers, and links. profile_posts (username): the account's latest public posts (Threads shows only the most recent ones). post (id): one post by URL or shortcode, with its replies (comments) and the author's own continuation posts (threadItems). profile and post return the item itself. List actions return { results, next_cursor, next }; Threads returns no further pages, so next_cursor is always null and no action takes a cursor.

end_date.description: search: only posts on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

id.description: post: Threads post URL or shortcode, example: 'DK-BydcJHkF' or 'https://www.threads.com/@zuck/post/DK-BydcJHkF'.

query.description: search: keyword or phrase, example: 'bittensor'. search_users: username or name, up to 100 characters, example: 'zuck'.

start_date.description: search: only posts on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD), example: '2026-01-01'.

username.description: profile, profile_posts: Threads username, example: 'zuck'. A leading @ is removed.

name: threads
title: Threads
